Dimension.description: Open vocabulary. Well-known values: always, format_option, placement, month, spot_length, buying_option, position, market, audience, geo. Vendor dimensions are namespaced (acmetv:daypart). A dimension the evaluator does not know makes the card non-evaluable locally; the seller's quote still binds (versioning.mdx:64-65).

IndexPointsRow.description: Adds points/100 to the factor of the fired index row on target_dimension (Ster: preferred position +30 points on the buying option index).

format_option_ref.description: For dimension format_option: fires when the selection carries this core format option reference.

value.description: Fires when the selection's value for dimension equals this. Absent for dimension always.

IndexPointsRow.title: Index Points Row

IndexRow.description: Multiplies the running price. First applicable row per dimension fires.

cap.description: provisional only: the fixed factor does not exceed this.

fixed_at.description: provisional only: when the seller fixes the factor.

format_option_ref.description: For dimension format_option: fires when the selection carries this core format option reference.

status.description: provisional: the factor is fixed after booking (Ster market index). The evaluator uses cap, so the result is a ceiling.

value.description: Fires when the selection's value for dimension equals this. Absent for dimension always.

IndexRow.title: Index Row

PremiumRow.description: Adds (fee) or subtracts (discount) a rate of the premium basis, or a fixed amount. Premiums do not compound with each other.

format_option_ref.description: For dimension format_option: fires when the selection carries this core format option reference.

value.description: Fires when the selection's value for dimension equals this. Absent for dimension always.

PremiumRow.title: Premium Row

RateCard.description: Price per pricing unit = base_price, times each fired index row in row order, then plus each fired premium. The parent pricing option's currency and pricing_model apply. quoted_selection is the selection the parent fixed_price quotes, so a buyer can reproduce fixed_price and price_breakdown.

premium_basis.description: What a premium rate applies to. adcp#7955 hard-codes indexed; GAM and most EU digital cards use base (rate-card market survey).

RateCard.title: Rate Card

RateCardBinding.description: The card signed for one purchase, and the selection it was priced at.
RateCardBinding.title: Rate Card Binding

Rounding.description: Seller-declared rounding. Ster rounds intermediate results to whole euros (rate-card market survey), which a fixed 4-decimal rule cannot reproduce.
Rounding.title: Rate Card Rounding

Selection.description: Selected value per dimension, plus the flight start used for row windows.

values.description: Dimension name to selected value, e.g. {"month": "2027-03", "spot_length": "20s"}.

Selection.title: Rate Card Selection

x-adcp-extension.description: Publishes a seller rate card so a buyer can evaluate prices locally while planning. Ports adcp#7955 (price_adjustments) with the changes that the PR #7955 review and the rate-card market survey asked for: an object container, an open dimension vocabulary, an explicit premium basis, seller-declared rounding, index-point rows, and provisional (capped) rows. The seller's quoted fixed_price and price_breakdown stay the binding contract.

extends.semantics: Planning aid. A buyer without this extension ignores it and uses fixed_price.
Signed card for one purchase. Provisional rows make the purchase price a ceiling that the seller re-quotes once it fixes the row.
